lines.text: Reads the model architecture from GGUF metadata without loading tensor
data. This is the runtime auto-selection signal; filenames are ignored.
Returns true when the file has a readable GGUF v3 container header.
Copies only the GGUF metadata and tensor descriptors needed to project
AFM safetensor shards. The resulting file is typically a few MiB and
makes an executor checkpoint self-contained without duplicating weights.
Header-only view of an AFM DeepSeek V4 safetensor checkpoint.
The catalog retains file-backed tensor locations so a fixed-schedule runtime
can map shard payloads directly without first materializing a second model.
A zero-copy projection of AFM safetensor shards into the contiguous address
layout expected by DwarfStar. The metadata file is small; tensor bytes stay
